scripts.check: bun run check:root && bun run check:qrcc && bun run check:noter && bun run check:portal && bun run check:tfstate
scripts.check:root: oxfmt --check . && oxlint --type-aware && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun scripts/check-versions.ts && tsc --build packages/ui packages/shell && bun run --cwd packages/ui lint:html && bun run --cwd packages/shell lint:html
scripts.test: bun run test:root && bun run test:qrcc && bun run test:noter && bun run test:portal && bun run test:tfstate
scripts.test:root: bun test ./scripts ./tools/oxlint-plugin-rimltools ./packages --path-ignore-patterns='packages/ui/**' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/shell/**' && bun run --cwd packages/ui test && bun run --cwd packages/shell test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd products/qrcc typecheck && bun run --cwd products/noter typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd products/qrcc build && bun run --cwd products/noter build && bun run --cwd products/portal build
scripts.clean: find . -maxdepth 5 -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && bun install
